policy: Open operational work must be explicit, owned, linked, review-dated and closed only by evidence. Malformed, unowned, untracked, contradictory or falsely closed status is a hard CI failure. Review-due status is an advisory warning in universal CI and becomes a hard stop only for a separately scoped action or current-state claim that actually relies on it.
